resources.string: Double-tap a free area to hide or show the object and compass panels, including the object name. Controls and reticle stay visible.
Reorganized view controls and a camera horizon half as thick as before.
Grid opacity defaults to 50%. Its slider updates immediately. Grid and reticle have no outline; reticle opacity is 80%.
Daytime fog, overcast skies and snow use black grid lines, above and below the horizon.
More compact popups, landscape title-bar actions and a close icon. Choices are retained when the screen rotates.
Zoom menus stay readable over the panels. The tutorial highlights a fixed free area and explains the controls in use.
